title: My lock said I came home at 3:02 🔒
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:02 in the morning, my smart lock said I had just come home.

scenes.narration: At 3:02 in the morning, my smart lock said I had just come home.
I was in bed. I had been home all night. I opened the app. Unlocked by you.
I scrolled the log. Every night, the same entry. Unlocked by you, 3:02. Locked by you, 3:19.
Seventeen minutes. Every night for two weeks. I never woke up. I never left.
So tonight, I stayed awake. I sat in the dark and watched the hallway. Phone in my hand.
At 3:02, the lock clicked. The door opened. Slowly. No light came in with it.
Footsteps. Careful. Familiar. They stopped at the coat hooks. I heard keys land on the shelf.
My keys. I looked at the shelf in the dark. They were not there. They were in my hand.
The footsteps came toward my room. And stopped outside the door. Waiting.
The app buzzed. Unlocked by you. Then a second line. Something is wearing your key. And it knows that you are already inside.
So tell me. Do you open the door, or hide?
